from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            height, width = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            if height < 3 or width < 3:
                continue
            expected = 2*height + 2*width - 4
            if len(cells) != expected:
                continue
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if height % 2 == 1 and width % 2 == 1 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-9ef55985.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
print(p, len(code))
